
func TestInProcessObserverHostLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	host := newTestHost(t)
	identity := fmt.Sprintf("instance_host:%p", host)
	t.Cleanup(func() { baselineobservation.Unregister(identity) })
	currentFactory := newLifecycleControlFactory(interfaces.FactoryStateRunning)
	current := startReadyHostedHandle(t, host, currentFactory, "observer-current")
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if !current.Completed() {
			_ = host.Stop(current)
		}
	})
	snapshot, err := baselineobservation.CaptureOwner(identity)
	if err != nil || snapshot.Host.HandleCount != 1 || snapshot.Host.Handles[0].Key != "observer-current" || snapshot.Host.Handles[0].HandleIdentity != fmt.Sprintf("%p", current) {
		t.Fatalf("current snapshot: %#v, %v", snapshot, err)
	}
	snapshot.Host.Handles[0].Key = "mutated-copy"
	replacementFactory := newLifecycleControlFactory(interfaces.FactoryStateRunning)
	replacement, err := host.Replace(instancehost.ReplaceRequest{Current: current, Replacement: testBundle(replacementFactory, "observer-replacement"), ServiceContext: t.Context(), ReadinessContext: t.Context()})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if !replacement.Completed() {
			_ = host.Stop(replacement)
		}
	})
	snapshot, err = baselineobservation.CaptureOwner(identity)
	if err != nil || snapshot.Host.HandleCount != 1 || snapshot.Host.Handles[0].Key != "observer-replacement" || snapshot.Host.Handles[0].HandleIdentity != fmt.Sprintf("%p", replacement) {
		t.Fatalf("replacement snapshot: %#v, %v", snapshot, err)
	}
	// Replacement retires the registry entry, not necessarily the old run loop.
	if err := host.lifecycle.Stop(current.(*factoryhost.Handle)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := host.Stop(replacement); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapshot, err = baselineobservation.CaptureOwner(identity)
	if err != nil || snapshot.Host.HandleCount != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("joined snapshot: %#v, %v", snapshot, err)
	}
}

func TestInProcessObserverHostConcurrentReads(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	host := newTestHost(t)
	identity := fmt.Sprintf("instance_host:%p", host)
	t.Cleanup(func() { baselineobservation.Unregister(identity) })
	done := make(chan struct{})
	var readers sync.WaitGroup
	readers.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer readers.Done()
		for {
			select {
			case <-done:
				return
			default:
			}
			snapshot, err := baselineobservation.CaptureOwner(identity)
			if err != nil || snapshot.Host.HandleCount != len(snapshot.Host.Handles) {
				t.Errorf("inconsistent snapshot: %#v, %v", snapshot, err)
				return
			}
		}
	}()
	for i := 0; i < 12; i++ {
		handle, err := host.Start(t.Context(), testBundle(newLifecycleControlFactory(interfaces.FactoryStateRunning), fmt.Sprintf("observer-%d", i)))
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			break
		}
		if err := host.Stop(handle); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			break
		}
	}
	close(done)
	readers.Wait()
}
